authentication_methods: OAuth M2M via tenant-bound local secret reference
Explicit access token via tenant-bound local secret reference
required_permissions: Metadata visibility for selected tables and columns
tenant_scope: secret reference binds tenant IDs and exact destination
network_destinations: Exact operator-registered public Databricks HTTPS workspace origin; redirects and private or special IP answers denied
source_identity_rules: Tables: metastore UUID plus table UUID. Schema: metastore, namespace and creation time; rename cannot be inferred. Columns: table identity plus column name; rename cannot be inferred. No absence reconciliation.
pagination: Unity Catalog REST2.1 max_results=0, follows opaque next_page_token across empty intermediate pages; repeated tokens,200 pages,10000 normalized records,8MiB or90s bound fail the entire scan.
incremental_cursor_behavior: No persistent cursor; bounded permission-filtered listing only.
retry_classes: Explicit source HTTP, rate-limit, permission and transport codes; no auth-bearing redirects or automatic write retries.
deletion_strategy: Disabled unconditionally for this connector. Permission-filtered listings do not establish absence, even when the principal and scope are unchanged.

limitations: Single selected catalog/schema metadata route; no source data rows or source-authored SQL.
Public workspace endpoints only; private-link and other network deployment profiles are not implemented.
Lists are permission-filtered and not an atomic metadata snapshot; no missing-asset reconciliation is authorized.
Column/schema renames lack immutable IDs and require explicit future reconciliation.
